sections.name: Home
sections.shared: Home is the workbench, not a statistics page: it shows what needs doing now. A section chooser summarises each section's workload; a section's Overview groups work by task type with timing and progress; picking a unit narrows the counts. Scan and Toolbox stay in reach, and the Assistant opens from the header.

patterns.name: Home task card
patterns.note: The card that summarises one task type on Overview: its name, progress and timing, and the way into the task.

sections.name: Tasks
sections.shared: All tasks look the same and only the information differs. Each task page is built from the same task skeleton: a header naming the task, a summary card, a lens bar with the count under each label, rows grouped by pen, a dock as the last row, and sheets and pages made of the same parts.

patterns.name: Task skeleton
patterns.note: Every task opens on the same page: header, last record, summary card (TaskSummary), lens tabs, rows grouped by pen, a dock. Only the information differs.

sections.name: Inspection
sections.shared: A walk through one unit. The worker sees every pig in it, including untagged groups, picks one or many, and records on the spot. The unit's equipment, environment and pen-count checks sit here too. There is no cohort and no lens: the unit is the scope.

sections.name: Pigs
sections.shared: Finding a pig and reading its record. Search takes an ear tag or ear notch, scan reads the tag, and untagged pigs appear as groups where one row means several head. Picking pigs raises one action sheet, the same for one pig or twenty.

sections.name: Health & treatments
sections.shared: Conditions, triage levels, deaths and treatments share one catalogue of diseases and symptoms and one action sheet. Whether an action is available depends on the pig's state, and a blocked pig is listed with the reason, never dropped silently.

sections.name: Breeding & litters
sections.shared: The sow's cycle events (heat, abortion, pregnancy, farrowing, weaning) and the litter events around them, such as fostering. Each event has one form and one record, whether it is reached from a task or from a pig's actions. The sow's state decides what is available.

sections.name: Measures & movement
sections.shared: Weight, backfat and temperature take one value per pig, so they are recorded one pig at a time. Transfer and missing reports apply one payload to the whole selection. All of them are reached from the same action sheet and write the same record from any door.

sections.name: Data sync
sections.shared: Records made on the phone wait there until the worker uploads them: Home shows a saved-work card, the Saved work drawer lists what waits, and upload is explicit and never loses a record. Draft from the Home study; the old design's per-pig and per-treatment detail is not built.
